module_summary: I2C initialization sequencer: an FSM steps an address register through a command ROM, decoding each entry into I2C master command and data stream transfers, with delay counter and data/address table pointers for multi-device mode.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/RUN/TABLE_1-3 sequencer state selecting how ROM commands are interpreted

anchors.name: init_data
anchors.why: Initialization command ROM read at address_next

anchors.name: init_data_reg
anchors.why: Current ROM command word decoded into write, address, delay, stop and table commands

anchors.name: address_reg
anchors.why: ROM program counter incremented per command, reloaded from table pointers

anchors.name: address_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Saved ROM offset of the next device address in address table

anchors.name: data_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Saved ROM offset of the data block start for multi-device mode

anchors.name: cur_address_reg
anchors.why: Current device address substituted for write-current-address commands

anchors.name: delay_counter_reg
anchors.why: Delay down-counter stalling the sequencer for 2**(16+d) cycles

anchors.name: start_flag_reg
anchors.why: Edge flag preventing re-run until start deasserts

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Start input launching the initialization sequence from IDLE

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy status while FSM not idle

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_valid
anchors.why: I2C command valid; stalls sequencer until accepted

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_ready
anchors.why: I2C master command ready clearing command valid and flags

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_address
anchors.why: I2C device address for the issued command

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_start
anchors.why: Command start bit set on address commands

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_write
anchors.why: Command write bit set on data writes

anchors.name: m_axis_cmd_stop
anchors.why: Command stop bit set on stop commands

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Write data valid; stalls sequencer until data accepted

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tready
anchors.why: Data stream ready clearing data valid

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tdata
anchors.why: 8-bit write data taken from ROM entry

groups.name: Init sequencer FSM
groups.description: Decodes ROM commands and sequences single and multi-device initialization

groups.name: Command ROM and pointers
groups.description: Init ROM with program counter, table pointers and current device address

groups.name: I2C command output
groups.description: Registered I2C master command stream with valid/ready handshake

groups.name: I2C data output
groups.description: Registered write-data stream to I2C master
